title: Turkish coffee in a cezve
scope: Stovetop, unfiltered, one-serving cezve; app-authored conservative cold-start single-rise baseline with separate named variants

sources.title: With cezve
supports: 6 g per cup; cup-measured water has unspecified volume; slow stirring to foam, foam distribution and return to heat

sources.title: STC Preparation: contemporary brew guide
supports: Separate 7/70 mass recipe, preferred warm start, grind distinction, initial mixing, removal before boiling and settling

sources.title: The UNESCO Courier April-June 2023: Turkish coffee, not just a drink but a culture, pp. 15-16
supports: Cold start, fine grinding, slow heating for foam, unfiltered grounds and small-cup tradition; parsed PDF text verified

sources.title: C1 Cezve / Turkish Coffee Pot: description and use & care
supports: C1 useful capacity 85 mL is model-specific; lining-safe utensils and washing; contact manufacturer about induction

sources.title: Turkish coffee culture and tradition, nomination 00645
supports: Access attempt recorded only; direct open returned JavaScript/human-verification challenge

recipe.name: App-authored conservative 6 g / 65 g cold-start single rise
equipment: Food-safe stovetop cezve with stable support, secure handle, manufacturer-compatible heat source and visible foam headroom

water_temperature_c.control: Cold drinking water at start; observed foam controls heated completion

recipe.grind_description: Powder fine Turkish coffee; ordinary espresso-fine grounds are not automatically suitable

expected_time_s.clock_start: Pot placed on heat after off-heat mixing
expected_time_s.clock_end: First controlled foam rise: remove before rolling boil; pouring and settling are separate

recipe.completion_signal: Foam expands upward; remove promptly before rim, rolling boil or overflow

steps.instruction: Check stable support, secure handle, compatibility and expansion space while cold.
steps.why: Headroom and heating behavior depend on the actual pot.
steps.completion: Suitable pot and burner selected; cup ready.

steps.instruction: Add 65 g cold water, 6 g powder coffee and optional sugar off heat.
steps.why: Water mass is this adaptation's choice, not a source cup volume.

steps.instruction: Mix off heat until no dry clumps remain; stop stirring afterward.
steps.why: Initial wetting and undisturbed heating are adaptation choices.

steps.instruction: Attend low heat; remove at first controlled foam rise before rolling boil or rim.
Pour gently into the stable cup; do not return to heat or filter.
steps.why: Single-rise unfiltered service defines this adaptation.

steps.instruction: Rest undisturbed for about 120 seconds, then check; wait longer as needed.
steps.why: App-chosen check, not a guarantee of safe temperature or settlement.
steps.completion: Comfortable small sip; leave sediment behind.

variants.name: STC contemporary warm start
variants.how_it_differs: Published 7 g/70 g; preferred ~60 C start, finer than espresso but coarser than traditional powder; initial mixing, reduced heat midway, ~120-150 s heating, remove before boiling, settle 120-180 s. Heating and settling clocks are separate.

variants.name: Mehmet Efendi producer procedure
variants.how_it_differs: 6 g per unspecified cup volume; slow stirring to foam, distribute foam, return to heat before service. Not the single-rise adaptation.

variants.name: Electric Turkish coffee machine
variants.how_it_differs: Follow that appliance's dose, fill and cleaning instructions; stovetop heat management does not transfer automatically.

troubleshooting.check_first: Fill level, support and heat control
troubleshooting.adjustment: Remove promptly; use lower heat next batch. Practical inference.

troubleshooting.check_first: Suitable grind, coffee freshness, vigorous boiling and stirring
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try fresher suitable coffee; do not extend heating just for foam. Practical inference.
Wait longer and leave bottom sediment. Practical inference.
Control heat, then change coffee or one measured quantity. Practical inference.

safety: Stay beside heated cezve; keep gas flame within base and handle clear. These are conservative open-pot precautions.
Remove before overflow; do not fill to rim or invent a universal headroom percentage.
Use stable serving cup; hot metal and liquid require careful handling.
Cool before cleaning and follow pot-specific care. Soy C1: wooden utensils, hand wash with mild soap, no abrasives, dishwasher or microwave; ask Soy about induction compatibility.

app_audit.finding: 6/65 and 12/130 recompute to 1:10.83; cold-start, observed completion and adaptation classes are explicit. No universal boiling duration is encoded.
Runtime provenance already labels single-rise and bounded two-rise as app-authored. Catalog loader applies these corrections.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Attribution is resolved; preserve immutable historical projection.

app_audit.finding: Single-rise typed settling cue is approximately 60-120 s; heat stages use observation, not countdowns. Live final-stage settling text also gives 1-2 minutes.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Label interval an app convenience; retain observable settling and drinkable-temperature checks. It is not a UNESCO numerical instruction.

app_audit.finding: Generic cezve guidance says finely ground coffee without a texture or espresso distinction.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Clarify powder-like traditional grind and that ordinary espresso-fine grounds need not be suitable; keep named contemporary exceptions contextual.

app_audit.finding: Earlier audit says settling is supported by Mehmet Efendi/UNESCO; accessed producer page and Courier tradition description contain no settling interval.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Separate unfiltered service from the app-chosen interval; cite an actual recipe if a numeric settling recommendation is retained.

app_audit.finding: Turkish coffee is absent from everyday BrewMethod enum; inspected grinders.json has no Turkish-specific mappings.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Do not describe P1 catalog presence as complete everyday-method support or expose universal grinder numbers.
Retain actual pot/headroom/heat-source review boundary; research alone does not clear the blocker.

uncertainties: No specific kitchen pot/heat source, safe numerical headroom or physical brewing outcome validated.
65 g water and single-rise stop are app choices; not an exact published traditional recipe.
Cold-start heating duration and finish temperature remain equipment-dependent and unspecified.
UNESCO heritage page was blocked; Courier original PDF text independently verifies limited tradition claims. PDF screenshot fetch failed with cache miss.
Settling 120 s is a first check, not a safe-temperature guarantee or universal sediment deadline.
No measurable finished beverage mass, retention factor or general grinder setting established.
do_not_claim: Single rise or two rises is universally authentic or optimal.
Arbitrary timed boiling is necessary; foam rise licenses prolonged rolling boil.
Mehmet Efendi specifies 65 mL or 65 g water per 6 g coffee.
Warm-start STC timing applies unchanged to cold water, all pot sizes or all heaters.
A universal grams-to-millilitres conversion, beverage yield, capacity or headroom percentage.
Physical brew, translated guide, native device flow or release readiness verified.
